daily-image.title: Image of the day
daily-image.body: Bing's photo of the day can now fill the reading pane when no message is open.

save-message.title: Save a message as a file
save-message.body: Save… in a message’s menu downloads it as EML, readable by every mail client, or as MSG for Outlook.

sender-avatars.title: Sender avatars
sender-avatars.body: The message list can now show each sender’s picture, or their initials, next to the message. Turn it on in Settings > Mail.

bimi-logos.title: Brand logos as sender avatars
bimi-logos.body: When a message passes the sender authenticity check, its avatar can now be the sender’s brand logo. It follows the same setting in Settings > Mail.

reader-expand.title: Expand the reader
reader-expand.body: The expand button in an open message’s toolbar hides the list and gives the whole space to the message. Click it again, or press Esc, to bring the list back.

palette-buttons.title: Button colour in light mode
palette-buttons.body: Appearance now lets you choose whether buttons wear the palette’s structure colour or its accent in light mode, for every built-in palette.

compose-window.title: Write in a floating window
compose-window.body: Settings > Mail now lets you open new messages in a floating window that stays open while you move around the app. On a phone, messages always open full page.
